card.name: Leading digit of numeric thresholds and ranges
card.fires_on: The first digit (or the word within) of a number that sets a cutoff or range limit, such as LVEF above 50%, a decline of 10% or more, CLcr 15 to 29, or weight 20 kg or greater.

modes.label: Cutoff digit
modes.description: A digit starting a percentage or weight threshold after symbols like above, ≥, or greater.

modes.label: Range bound
modes.description: A digit or the word within in a numeric range for renal function, dose ranges, or equivalence limits.

card.writes: It seems to steer away from words like minimum, maximum and threshold, so the text carries on with the number itself rather than naming the limit.
card.plain: It lights up on the first digit of a number that marks a cutoff or range, like an ejection fraction of 50% or a kidney function band.
